title: Adolfo Bioy Casares delay
subtitle: My Amazon shipment is postponed from this fall until April 11, 2028 (!). Will it ever come? Of course this is the fantastic, and long, Bioy Cesares book Borges, his memoir of their friendship. How can the reoptimization both be so distant and so exact in timing?
contentHtml:
My Amazon shipment is postponed from this fall until April 11, 2028 (!).

Will it ever come?

Of course this is the fantastic, and long, Bioy Cesares book Borges, his memoir of their friendship.

How can the reoptimization both be so distant and so exact in timing?
